metadata.problem: The runtime needs one explicit request boundary.
Copied component identities reduce ambiguous discovery.
Requests need role-aware target extraction and explicit constraints without a second model call.
Execution needs an auditable intent, permission, budget, and validation scope.
The agent must retrieve selected records instead of loading the repository.
Execution needs an explicit byte-counted read plan, flow phase, skips, validators, and missing input.
Named reuse needs one compact discovery index and current readiness projection.
Exact token edits need one value authority.
Executable APIs, semantics, accessibility, and runtime need one authority.
Contract-changing work needs detailed rules without loading unrelated families.
Brand-sensitive choices need implementation-mapped visual intent.
Effort and permissions must scale to the classified task.
Named values should change through the shortest possible path.
Existing assets should be imported and used without contract expansion.
Pages and local sections should combine selected existing components.
Broken behavior needs restoration without changing component identity.
Public API expansion must be intentional and validated.
A genuinely missing reusable asset may be created only after explicit permission and gap proof.
Page or section creation must not silently expand the public design system.
New assets require proof that no exact match or suitable alternative exists.
Mechanical reuse should skip brand context while open visual choices require it.
New visual direction and propagation scope need a human decision.
The smallest affected validator should detect failures without paying for every audit.
Repair must stop instead of ruminating indefinitely.
Routing, permissions, budgets, and exclusions need deterministic tests.
Registry identities and public sources must remain one-to-one.
Approved visual rules must reference real implementation mechanisms.
A successful run needs one concise terminal handoff.
Missing input or exhausted repair needs a clear terminal state instead of guessing.
Figma must remain outside normal Astro latency.
Selected visual exploration and projection need an optional external surface.
An explicit Figma task should load only the selected adapter and mapping scope.
Representative prompts should measure routing quality outside normal request latency.
Eval findings may improve later runs but must not mutate the current run.
Source history should live in Git instead of runtime registries.
Reusable UI needs shared values before component composition.
Primitive components establish the first reusable layer.
Small compositions depend on primitives.
Reusable content containers compose smaller parts.
Large reusable regions compose atoms, molecules, and cards.
Page structures compose ready reusable regions.

stages.title: Classify
stages.description: Turn the prompt into a small default-deny Task Contract.

stages.title: Resolve Context
stages.description: Retrieve only selected sources and produce a bounded Context Pack.

stages.title: Execute
stages.description: Run exact edit, reuse, compose, repair, extend, or gated creation.

stages.title: Validate
stages.description: Run scoped checks and a bounded repair loop.

stages.title: Result
stages.description: Terminate as accepted or blocked with a concise handoff.

stages.title: Creation Gate
stages.description: Allow public component creation only after explicit intent and gap proof.

stages.title: Brand Activation
stages.description: Load matching approved rules only for brand-sensitive choices.

stages.title: Explicit Figma
stages.description: Use one selected Figma operation only after an explicit request.

stages.title: Eval Harness
stages.description: Measure representative prompts between runs and improve future routing.

instances.title: User Prompt
instances.summary: The requested change, exact names, and target scope.

instances.title: Exact Guide Identity
instances.summary: Optional copied component or token identity removes discovery ambiguity.

instances.title: Classify
instances.summary: Select exact-edit, reuse, compose, repair, extend, or create.

instances.title: Task Contract
instances.summary: Records targets, creation permission, brand mode, budget, and validation scope.

instances.title: Resolve Context
instances.summary: Query only the records and files needed by the Task Contract.

instances.title: Component Registry
instances.summary: Discovery identity and current readiness; one selected record at a time.

instances.title: CSS Variables
instances.summary: Value truth for exact token and affected styling work.
instances.purpose: Resolve semantic values without broad component context.

instances.title: Astro Sources
instances.summary: Executable component API, semantics, and runtime.

instances.title: Selected Rules
instances.summary: Detailed category guidance only for repair, extend, or create.

instances.title: Context Pack
instances.summary: Required reads, skipped contexts, validators, alternatives, and missing inputs.

instances.title: Select Execution Profile
instances.summary: Scale effort and permissions to the classified task.
instances.purpose: Prevent heavy workflows for small changes.

instances.title: Exact Edit
instances.summary: Edit one named value or property.

instances.title: Named Reuse
instances.summary: Import and use an existing component.

instances.title: Compose
instances.summary: Combine named components into a page or local section.
instances.purpose: Produce layouts without public system expansion.

instances.title: Repair
instances.summary: Restore an existing component contract.

instances.title: Extend
instances.summary: Change an existing API only after explicit intent.

instances.title: Create
instances.summary: Create a genuinely missing reusable component after the Creation Gate.

instances.title: Scoped Validation
instances.summary: Run the smallest validators selected for the affected change.
instances.purpose: Catch relevant failures without a universal validation tax.

instances.title: Bounded Repair
instances.summary: Retry once for exact/reuse and at most twice for other profiles.

instances.title: Accepted
instances.summary: Return intent, reused assets, changed files, and validation.

instances.title: Blocked
instances.summary: Return missing input, alternatives, or exhausted repair.

instances.title: Explicit Creation Intent
instances.summary: A page or section request keeps allowNewComponents false.
instances.purpose: Protect the public system from accidental growth.

instances.title: Gap Proof
instances.summary: Check exact matches and reusable alternatives before creating.

instances.title: Brand Activation
instances.summary: Skip for exact edit and named reuse; activate for open visual choices.
instances.purpose: Pay brand context only when it changes decisions.

instances.title: Approved Contract Rules
instances.summary: Return only matching implementation-mapped rules.
instances.purpose: Translate brand decisions to real CSS and components.

instances.title: Human Visual Approval
instances.summary: Approve new visual direction or propagation scope.
instances.purpose: Keep subjective direction under human control.

instances.title: Explicit Figma Request
instances.summary: Normal Astro work bypasses this side path.

instances.title: Selected Figma Operation
instances.summary: Load one adapter and synchronize only the selected scope.
instances.purpose: Use Figma as an occasional visual repository.

instances.title: Figma Visual Repository
instances.summary: Editable visual projection for exploration and review.
instances.purpose: Support optional visual iteration without becoming code truth.

instances.title: Representative Eval Cases
instances.summary: Run Polish and English prompts outside normal request latency.
instances.purpose: Measure routing, context, first-pass quality, and unnecessary reads.

instances.title: Future Routing Improvement
instances.summary: Apply reviewed findings only to future requests.
instances.purpose: Avoid mutating or retrying the current run invisibly.

traces.title: Exact Token Edit
traces.description: Tiny path: resolve one token, edit it, validate the affected foundation, and stop.

traces.title: Reuse Existing Asset
traces.description: Resolve one named component and use it without brand, family-rule, history, or Figma context.

traces.title: Compose Page or Section
traces.description: Resolve selected components and compose them without public component creation.

traces.title: Repair Existing Component
traces.description: Load one matching family rule, repair the existing contract, and retry within a fixed limit.

traces.title: Create Reusable Component
traces.description: Require explicit creation intent, gap proof, detailed rules, and full affected validation.

traces.title: Brand-Sensitive Composition
traces.description: Add only matching approved contract rules and require human approval for new direction.

traces.title: Explicit Figma Operation
traces.description: Branch from classification only after an explicit Figma request.

traces.title: Eval Flywheel
traces.description: Run representative cases explicitly and feed reviewed changes only into future routing.
